title: This Claude Code Trick Saves Thousands in Credits
description:
Most Claude Code users are burning through credits doing things the hard way. This command stack fixes that. Slash ultra plan, slash goal, slash agents, slash ultra review — string all four together and you have an agentic loop that runs for days. The best part is you can run the whole thing locally with Claude Code and skip the extra cost entirely. This is the Claude Code workflow and tutorial most people never find.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Jn8FMIizEMgRD0dI-m31cKYj7eHLXaJ1AWIQ2YmEUFs/edit?usp=sharing

#claudecode #claudetutorial #claudeskills #claudecodecommands #aiworkflow
transcript: Nobody's talking about this Claude Code command stack. Four slash commands that turn Claude Code into an agent loop. One thing before we get into it, follow the page. I post Claude Code stuff like this every day. Here's a secret. Slash ultra plan, slash goal, slash agents, slash ultra review. This is the most powerful native Claude Code command stack right now. Here's what each one does and how you string them together. Slash ultra plan deploys a bunch of sub agents on Anthropic servers to build you a complete detailed plan. And if you're smart, you recreate create that plan locally and run it yourself. Then slash goal takes that plan and loops Claude Code over it until the actual goal is achieved. It can loop for days. Slash agents lets you zoom out of that session entirely and run it in the background so you can spin up a whole new parallel session while the first one keeps going. Once it finishes, you zoom back in and run slash ultra review, which deploys sub agents to audit every line of code that came out of that loop. And again, if you're really smart, you do that one locally too so you don't burn through your credits. Comment loop below and I'll send you the local slash command setup for all four.
